key_insight: DiagTrace evaluates how LLMs seek diagnostic evidence step by step, rather than judging only a final diagnosis from fully supplied patient information.
clinical_relevance: The benchmark examines information-seeking behavior relevant to clinical reasoning, but does not establish safety or effectiveness in patient care.
method: Build source-grounded cases from PubMed Central case reports.
Provide an initial presentation, event bank, documented clinical course, and diagnostic references.
Assess interactive reconstruction of the documented diagnostic trajectory.
evidence_signal: DiagTrace contains 510 cases across eight specialties; evaluation of four LLMs on 225 cases revealed trade-offs in coverage, source-consistent ordering, and turn use.
watch_item: Alignment with a published case trajectory should not be equated with an optimal diagnostic strategy or real-world clinical validity.
paper_title: DiagTrace: An Interactive Benchmark for Clinical Decision Making
